shoe cabinet located near a jacket, a pillar, and a case.
cabinet located to the right of the desk. the cabinet is white and has a window.

table with the tv on it. the table is located to the right of the tv.

white desk with a computer monitor on it. the desk is located to the right of the chair and slightly below the monitor. you can find it by looking in the region where the desk's bounding box intersects with the chair's bounding box. once you locate the desk, look for the computer monitor which is placed on top of it.

board, which is an easel with a whiteboard on it. it is located near a stand and a vase. the stand is towards the left of the board, while the vase is towards the right. additionally, there is a plant near the bottom-right corner of the board.
